job.title: Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

An agency needs project managers who speak the language of clients and developers – I have bridged both on large SAP Commerce online shops at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Requirements, user stories and UAT with business teams
– Deep shop know-how: catalog, promotions, OMS, integrations
– Agile delivery with Jira and Confluence

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for eBakery.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Project Manager | Requirements, Integrations & Delivery | SAP Commerce
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years delivering enterprise B2B and B2C online shops (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates business requirements into user stories, functional specifications and working solutions; coordinates with product owners, business teams and international developers in agile setups with Jira and Confluence. Strong understanding of shop technology: product catalogs, promotions, order management, ERP / PIM integrations, release cycles and production support. Uses AI tools to accelerate analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: eBakery builds and grows online shops for brands, combining strategy, design and technology. I want to bring my mix of shop technology and requirements work to client projects where a clear translation between business goals and development makes the difference. Your hands-on agency culture in Frankfurt is a strong match.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your E-Commerce Project Manager role fits my background: 5+ years on large SAP Commerce shops at Rockwell Automation and Shell, bridging business requirements and development. Start 16.12.2026. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: Projektmanager E-Commerce
en.hook: An agency like eBakery needs project managers who speak the language of clients and developers alike. That is where I have worked for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I gather requirements with business teams, translate them into user stories and specifications and follow them through to live features on large SAP Commerce online shops.

bullets.label: Client requirements
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Translating into delivery
bullets.text: Wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions together with technical teams.

bullets.label: E-commerce know-how
bullets.text: Developed and maintained promotions, order management (OMS), product catalog and pricing functionality, plus PIM and ERP integrations across global channels.

bullets.label: Releases & quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), supported production issues and performed code reviews in agile teams.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at eBakery on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
